title: Strangler vs Big-Bang Migration: How to Choose
description: Stripe converted 3.7 million lines to TypeScript in one pull request; Twitch moved to Go endpoint by endpoint. Four factors help explain which to choose.
og_alt: Editorial card reading Incremental Is Not Always Safer, for an article comparing strangler and big-bang migrations.
